newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Stolen Berlin police chief's car surfaces in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Stolen Berlin police chief's car surfaces in Moscow.

text.p: A car used by Berlin's chief of police, stolen in the German capital more than two years ago, has reappeared in Moscow, Russia's Sevodnya newspaper said on Wednesday.
Sevodnya said the Mercedes, possibly stolen in Berlin as Russian troops pulled out of eastern Germany, was handed back to German police representatives in Moscow.
The car, an official vehicle, was stolen in broad daylight on a busy avenue in the city in May 1994.
Cars stolen in western Europe often reappear in Russia and other former Soviet satellite states in central and eastern Europe. Few stolen vehicles are ever recovered.
